summary: Awards, a wide treatment menu and WhatsApp booking are strengths, but a booking form with almost no fields and many mismatched menu links appear to cost you consultations.

findings.problem: The Book Your Consultation section shows only Choose Treatment and SUBMIT, with no name, phone, email or date fields, and Thanks for submitting! shows before anyone submits.
findings.cost: A patient ready to book cannot leave details and you cannot call back.
findings.fix: A complete booking form with a real confirmation.

findings.problem: Wrinkle Treatments, Anti Aging Injections and Dermal Fillers all link to one page, Rosacea & Sunspots links to the BBL page, and the Disclaimer link goes to the booking page.
findings.cost: Wrong links send patients to the wrong treatment.

findings.problem: The brand appears as EDEN AESTHETICS Clinic, Eden Derma Clinic Dubai Aesthetics and EDEN Aesthetics, and 'Bacial for Back' and 'impants' appear in menus and addresses.
findings.cost: Changing names and typos weaken a premium brand.
findings.fix: One brand name and proofread copy.

findings.problem: Only one testimonial shows, from 'Amani secret', award images carry no issuing body, and the footer shows the odd code X5FWOSSO.
findings.cost: Thin proof and leftover code reduce trust.
findings.fix: A full review wall, linked awards and a clean footer.

redesign: A complete booking form with WhatsApp.
One correct page per treatment and one brand name.
A full review wall with linked awards.
